name: Nexora Animated Promo Messages for WooCommerce
author: Amin

sections.description:
Turn passive visitors into buyers with high-impact promotional messages.

Nexora Animated Promo Messages for WooCommerce helps you display powerful, conversion-focused messages directly on your product and shop pages — exactly where buying decisions happen.

Instead of relying on static badges or theme limitations, Nexora gives you full control to create and display unlimited promotional messages that grab attention and drive action.

🚀 Why It Works

Customers don’t always notice discounts, stock alerts, or shipping benefits.

But they do respond to:

✔ Offers → “Save 25% Today”
✔ Urgency → “Only 3 left in stock”
✔ Incentives → “Free Shipping on Orders Over $50”
✔ Social Proof → “Best Seller”

Nexora brings these messages front and center — increasing visibility, engagement, and conversions.

💡 Real Use Cases That Drive Growth

  • Promote campaigns with flash sale messages
  • Boost AOV with free shipping thresholds
  • Increase conversions with limited stock alerts
  • Highlight trust signals like best seller / popular product
  • Guide buyers with key product benefits
  • Run seasonal offers without editing product pages

⚙️ How It Works

  1. Create a message set from admin panel
  2. Add unlimited promotional messages
  3. Customize style, icons, and animations
  4. Assign to specific products or apply globally
  5. Publish — and start converting

No coding. No complexity. Full control.

🔥 Key Features

  • Create unlimited promotional messages per set
  • Assign message sets per product or globally
  • Display on product pages and shop/archive pages
  • Smooth animations (fade, slide, rotate)
  • Add custom icons for better visibility
  • Flexible styling (color, size, alignment)
  • Lightweight & fast (no heavy libraries)
  • Loads only where needed (performance optimized)
  • SEO-friendly & accessible markup
  • Works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme

💎 What Makes Nexora Different?

Most WooCommerce stores use:

❌ Static sale badges
❌ Hardcoded theme labels
❌ Limited customization

Nexora gives you:

✔ Dynamic, attention-grabbing promo messages
✔ Flexible targeting (per product or global)
✔ Marketing-focused UI for quick setup
✔ Clean, modern display similar to top marketplaces
✔ Performance-first architecture (no bloat)

🎯 Built for Store Owners Who Want Results

If you want to:

  • Increase conversions without redesigning your store
  • Highlight offers more effectively
  • Create urgency without extra plugins
  • Control marketing directly from WordPress

Then Nexora is built for you.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Nexora Promo Messages for WooCommerce”
  3. Click Install and Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Upload plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/nexora-promo-messages-for-woocommerce
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen

After Activation

  1. Go to Promo Messages → Message Sets
  2. Click Add New
  3. Create your promotional messages
  4. Assign to products or apply globally
  5. Publish
sections.faq:
How do I show a promotional message on a

WooCommerce product page? =
Install the plugin, create a message set from
the admin panel, and assign it to a specific
product or globally. Messages appear automatically
with smooth animations.

Can I show different promo messages on

different products? =
Yes. You can create unique message sets for
individual products or apply one set across
all products globally.

How do I add urgency to my WooCommerce

product page? =
Create messages like “Only 3 left in stock”
or “Sale ends today” and assign them to your
products. The plugin displays them with
attention-grabbing animations.

Does it work on WooCommerce shop and

archive pages? =
Yes. The plugin supports both single product
pages and shop or category archive pages.

Will this plugin slow down my WooCommerce store?

No. The plugin loads only on pages where
messages are assigned and uses no heavy
external libraries.

Can I show animated text promotions instead

of image badges? =
Yes. Unlike most badge plugins that use images,
this plugin uses animated rotating text messages
which are fully customizable and lightweight.
